result.stdout:
Kaniff — your developer Swiss Army knife.

Usage:
  kaniff <command> [options]

Commands:
  ip [--local] [--public]         Show public and/or local IP addresses
  base64 encode <text> [-u]       Encode text to Base64 (-u = URL-safe)
  base64 decode <text>            Decode Base64 to text
  url encode|decode <text>        Percent-encode/decode for URLs
  jwt <token>                     Decode a JWT header and payload
  hash <text>                     MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 of text
  uuid [count] [-u]               Generate random UUID(s)
  timestamp [unix|date]           Convert Unix time <-> date (now if empty)
  case <text>                     Convert between casing styles
  color <hex|rgb(...)>            Convert a color to HEX/RGB/HSL
  regex <pattern> <input> [-i]    Test a regex and list matches
  qr <text> [--png file.png]      Generate a QR code (ASCII or PNG)
  strcmp <a> <b> [-i] [-w]        Compare two strings (-i ignore case, -w ignore whitespace)
  json format <json>              Pretty-print JSON
  json minify <json>              Minify JSON
  json validate <json>            Validate JSON
  list                            List available tools

Most text commands also read from stdin, e.g.:
  echo "aGVsbG8=" | kaniff base64 decode

result.stdout:
ip       My IP — Show your public IP (ifconfig.me with fallbacks) and local addresses.
base64   Base64 Encode/Decode — Convert text to and from Base64 (standard or URL-safe).
url      URL Encode/Decode — Percent-encode or decode text for URLs.
jwt      JWT Decoder — Inspect a JWT's header and payload (no signature verification).
hash     Hash — Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes of text.
uuid     UUID Generator — Generate one or more random version-4 UUIDs.
timestamp Timestamp Converter — Convert Unix time to a date and back (seconds or milliseconds).
case     Case Converter — Convert text to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more.
color    Color Converter — Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL.
regex    Regex Tester — Test a regular expression and inspect matches and groups.
qr       QR Code — Generate a QR code from text (ASCII or PNG).
strcmp   String Comparer — Compare two strings and locate the first difference.
json     JSON Format/Minify — Pretty-print, minify and validate JSON documents.
